entries.title: Psalms 146:1
segments: Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 146:2
segments: While I live I will praise the LORD; I will sing praises to my God while I have any being.

entries.title: Psalms 146:3
segments: Do not put your trust in princes, [nor] in the son of man in whom [there is] no salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 146:4
segments: His breath goes forth; he returns to the earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

entries.title: Psalms 146:5
segments: Blessed [is] he who [has] the God of Jacob for his help, whose help [is] in the LORD his God,

entries.title: Psalms 146:6
segments: who made the heavens and earth, the sea and all that [is] in it; who keeps truth forever;

entries.title: Psalms 146:7
segments: who carries out judgment for the mistreated; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD lets the prisoners loose;

entries.title: Psalms 146:8
segments: the Lord opens [the eyes of] the blind; the LORD raises those who are bowed down; the LORD loves the righteous;

entries.title: Psalms 146:9
segments: the LORD preserves the strangers; He relieves the orphan and widow, but the way of the wicked He turns upside down.

entries.title: Psalms 146:10
segments: The LORD shall reign forever, even your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
